name: Bind Spirit IV
body:
School conjuration (calling) [pact]; Level sorcerer/wizard 8, shaman 8, witch 8

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as bind spirit I†, except you summon a 4thlevel pact spirit of your choice and bind it to your soul.
